```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

```

```{r}

drafts = load_draft_picks(seasons = 1994:2015)

# start in 1994 since that's when NFL draft first had the current seven-round format

draft_data = drafts %>%
  select(season, round, pick, pfr_player_name, position, category, team, w_av)

```
